Diagnosis.Molecular Markers: pMMR, MS-Stable, Tumor mutational burden = 5 Muts/Mb, KRAS G12V, TP53 I195F, VUS: CBL P782L, CDKN2A/B loss, MTOR R2109, NKX2-1 G239_G241del, PDGFRB V523M, PIK3C2G T488A, TNFAIP3 P752S

Additional Comments: The patient, a 58-year-old male with locally advanced pancreatic adenocarcinoma, has been on a chemotherapy break since November 2018 after completing 8 cycles of FOLFIRINOX. He reports feeling very well, maintaining a good exercise routine and diet, and experiencing intermittent but non-increasing upper abdominal pain. Molecular testing revealed the tumor is microsatellite stable (MS-Stable) with a tumor mutational burden of 5 Muts/Mb, and specific genetic mutations including KRAS G12V, TP53 I195F, and several others. The patient has decided to hold off on additional imaging for now and plans to return for a follow-up in June 2019, with a new CT scan scheduled for July 2019.
